remarks: Fantastic 1 bedroom in East Norwalk! - Updated kitchen features white shaker-style cabinets, stainless steel appliances, and granite counters! - Updated bathroom - Newer flooring - Small walk-in closet in bedroom + great storage closet in hallway - Gas heat and central air! - Great off-street parking area - Convenient location... walk to restaurants and East Norwalk train! - Easy access to I-95 - Shared back yard space + shared washer / dryer in basement - No pets!
